mapper.select: /* selectBuyerMpSoChangeAccountPopList */ SELECT A.BUYER, A.CODE1 AS REQ_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = A.CODE1) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, B.CODE1 AS BUDGET_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.CODE1) AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, B.CODE2 AS ACCOUNT_CODE, DECODE(C.FLAG, 'Y', '[선택불가] ', 'N', '[선택가능] ', '') || C.TEXT1 AS ACCOUNT_NAME, NVL(SUM(D.TARGET_QTY * D.TARGET_PRICE), 0) AS TARGET_AMT, C.FLAG AS POSB_FLAG FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMCOD3 B, ICOMCOD2 C, ICOMPRDT D WHERE 1=1 AND A.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND A.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND A.CODE1 = #{dept_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.CODE2 = B.CODE1 AND B.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND B.BUYER = C.COMPANY_CODE AND B.CODE2 = C.CODE AND ((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.CODE1) LIKE '%' || #{st_budget_dept} || '%' OR B.CODE1 LIKE '%' || #{st_budget_dept} || '%') AND C.TYPE = 'Z014' AND (C.TEXT1 LIKE '%' || #{st_account} || '%' OR B.CODE2 LIKE '%' || #{st_account} || '%') AND A.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND A.CODE1 = D.REQ_DEPT(+) AND B.CODE1 = D.BUDGET_DEPT(+) AND B.CODE2 = D.ACCOUNT_TYPE(+) AND D.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND D.CHANGE_DATE(+) BETWEEN REPLACE(#{startDate}, '/', '') AND REPLACE(#{endDate}, '/', '') AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUDGET_FLAG = 'Y') GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.CODE1, B.CODE1, B.CODE2, C.TEXT1, C.FLAG ORDER BY A.BUYER, C.FLAG, TARGET_AMT DESC, B.CODE1, B.CODE2

/* selectBuyerMpSoChangeAccountPopList_v2 */ SELECT A.BUYER, A.CODE1 AS REQ_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = A.CODE1) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, B.CODE1 AS BUDGET_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.CODE1) AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, B.CODE2 AS ACCOUNT_CODE, C.TEXT1 AS ACCOUNT_NAME, NVL(SUM(D.TARGET_QTY * D.TARGET_PRICE), 0) AS TARGET_AMT, C.FLAG AS POSB_FLAG FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMCOD3 B, ICOMCOD2 C, ICOMPRDT D WHERE 1=1 AND A.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND A.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND A.CODE1 = #{dept_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.CODE2 = B.CODE1 AND B.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND B.BUYER = C.COMPANY_CODE AND B.CODE2 = C.CODE AND ((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.CODE1) LIKE '%' || #{st_budget_dept} || '%' OR B.CODE1 LIKE '%' || #{st_budget_dept} || '%') AND C.TYPE = 'Z014' AND (C.TEXT1 LIKE '%' || #{st_account} || '%' OR B.CODE2 LIKE '%' || #{st_account} || '%') AND A.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND A.CODE1 = D.REQ_DEPT(+) AND B.CODE1 = D.BUDGET_DEPT(+) AND B.CODE2 = D.ACCOUNT_TYPE(+) AND D.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND D.CHANGE_DATE(+) BETWEEN REPLACE(#{startDate}, '/', '') AND REPLACE(#{endDate}, '/', '') AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUDGET_FLAG = 'Y') GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.CODE1, B.CODE1, B.CODE2, C.TEXT1, C.FLAG ORDER BY A.BUYER, C.FLAG, TARGET_AMT DESC, B.CODE1, B.CODE2
